title: The Arched Pavilion
description: A modern home designed with elegant arch-shaped verandas and a clean, simple look. The house focuses on comfortable outdoor spaces that stay cool and shaded, creating a peaceful and stylish living environment.

title: The Mosaic Terracotta
description: A renovation project in Yaoundé that transforms an old commercial and residential building into a more attractive and modern space. The design uses warm terracotta colors and unique patterns to improve the building’s appearance and strength.

title: The Amber Meridian
description: A striking residential building designed with bright colors and modern balconies. Each apartment includes a private outdoor space, offering residents comfort while giving the building a bold urban presence.

title: The Terracotta Collective
description: A multi-family residential complex designed for comfort and natural airflow. The warm earth-colored exterior and spacious balconies create a welcoming and balanced living environment for residents.

title: The Crimson Crest Estate
description: A large residential estate designed with a bold roof style and multiple levels. Wide balconies and a strong structural design create a spacious and impressive living space.

title: The Graphite Monolith
description: A modern residential building with a strong stone-like exterior and decorative design features. The balconies and bold color contrasts give the building a unique and powerful appearance.

title: The Meridian Foundation
description: This project highlights the early construction stage of a large residential estate. The focus is on building a strong reinforced concrete structure that will support a safe and durable building.

title: The Skyline Skeleton
description: A multi-story residential building currently under construction. The design focuses on strong structural work and well-placed windows that allow natural light and good ventilation for every floor.

title: The Highland Manor
description: A spacious home designed with a wide layout and a distinctive tiered roof. The house provides large interior spaces and a strong visual presence surrounded by natural greenery.

title: The Lions Gate Atrium
description: A modern commercial and residential building with large glass windows and stylish wood accents. The design allows plenty of natural light and offers beautiful views of the surrounding city.

title: The Rosewood Columns
description: A multi-story residential building with a warm exterior color and elegant white columns. Spacious balconies and a secure gated design create a comfortable and attractive living environment.

title: The Crimson Corner
description: A modern residential building with bold colors and unique corner balconies. The design maximizes natural light and city views while giving the building a strong contemporary style.

title: Modern Horizon Villa
description: A modern home designed with clean architectural lines and large windows that allow plenty of natural light. The design combines comfort, style, and open living spaces.

title: Riverside Estate Development
description: A large residential estate currently under construction. The project focuses on building a strong structure that will support comfortable and modern living spaces.
